newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle prices steady-off $1-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle prices steady-off $1-USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt lower, compared to same sales last week, USDA said. Cattle Receipts: 1,950.
Feeder Steers: Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 73.50-80.50; 700-800 lbs 74.50-79.25; 800-900 lbs 66.00-75.50; 12 head 1033 lbs 66.90. Medium and Large 2 500-600 lbs few 70.00-78.50.
Feeder Heifers: Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 69.00-76.75; 800-900 lbs 61.30-70.25. Medium and Large 2 500- 600 lbs 66.50-73.00.
